### Caprebate — Stage 2 document upload list: add the free fixture-evidence documents the client already holds (see subitems)

`12818978746` · **Built - awaiting sign-off** · owner CTA · Lakhbir Dhillon

- File: `08-monday-doc-exports/12818978746__3.-The-screen-as-the-client-sees-it.md`
- Subitems (10) — a catalogue: blank rows here are data, not unfinished work:
  - O&M manuals from any refurbishment — every piece of plant installed, with model numbers, capacities and commissioning dates. A complete equipment schedule — `12818982010`
  - Grant / NHS premises funding agreement — where any spend was grant-funded. Deducted before anything else is calculated — `12819010569`
  - Asbestos register — mandatory pre-2000 buildings. Room-by-room materials survey; also shows what is original vs replaced — `12818992146`
  - Lease + licence for alterations — decides who owns the fixtures and whether the tenant has a claimable interest — `12818992321`
  - CPSE replies (conveyancing) — the s.187A pooling answer. Highest-stakes document in the system — `12818982054`
  - Contractor's elemental cost breakdown — where invoices exist they beat any apportionment. Evidence, not opinion — `12818968807`
  - Insurance reinstatement valuation — independent rebuild cost estimate, often surveyor-prepared. Cross-check on A+B from outside our own cost library — `12818992083`
  - Fire risk assessment — room-by-room list of alarm, emergency lighting, compartmentation, fire doors, sprinklers. Nearly all qualifying plant. Every care home has one, updated regularly — `12818982791`
  - Sale contract + any s.198 election schedule — the elected value caps the fixtures claim regardless of building value — `12818992084`
  - Building Regs completion certificate — confirms what was actually built vs approved. NO national API; council copies ~£144 and unavailable for private approved inspector jobs. Client upload is faster and cheaper — `12818992673`
